description: TikTok hashtag stats from TikTok's public hashtag detail JSON: hashtag ID, title, description, exact video count and total view count, average views per video and commerce flag, for up to 10 hashtags compared side by side (sorted by views). Lifetime totals only: no time series, no top-video list and no audience demographics. Unknown hashtags are listed under notFound. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
